{{Quote|Well, either the Corulag Bureau of Tourism is giving away free Death Stars to the first million visitors, or else the Empire knew we were coming and grossly overestimated our capabilities.|[[Cryle Cavv]]|<ref name="SF">{{JournalCite|12|Small Favors}}</ref>}}
The '''Corulag Bureau of Tourism''' was an organization based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]]. After arriving at Corulag to find a large [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starship/Legends|ships]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], [[Cryle Cavv]] joked that maybe the gathering was a result of the Corulag Bureau of Tourism giving away free [[Death Star/Legends|Death Stars]].<ref name="SF" />
